sbar.situation: The bank's clearing service has recovered and payments are clearing again. Two recovery checks ran the main journey, and both were clean, the last at 26 seconds.
sbar.background: The clearing worker crashed with exit code 1 on a JSONDecodeError while parsing a queued item. No recent release or config change to clearing is recorded, and 120 items backed up behind item 90 at the head of the queue.
sbar.assessment: The root cause was a malformed (poison) message, item 90, at the head of the clearing queue (confidence 0.85). The incident commander quarantined item 90, which succeeded, and then restarted clearing itself, which also succeeded.
sbar.recommendation: The operations team has been asked to review item 90 soon. They should repair and resubmit it, or close it with its customer, because that payment has not cleared.
